conclusion: No complete, legitimate implementation of all nine SfRoutineNativePort operations and the five C07 callables was identified within owned paths using the inspected published public boundaries. Genuine Tool.Context capture in an owned callback is possible; the missing information in TrustedDomainContext alone is not an impossibility proof. The unresolved chain is canonical Task provenance plus approved plan/arm/admission and durable SF correlation/terminal facts, with a separate conditional knowledge-author problem.

auditAddenda.finding: The real Tool.Context is available in the owned contribution.ts execute(payload, context). A private lexical/lease-bound capture can preserve that real context without exposing it to the model or extending foreign contracts. It remains the context of sf_*, not a recorded task invocation, so replaying it into Task cannot pass requireParent. The failure is not merely missing fields in TrustedDomainContext.

auditAddenda.finding: Public Relay.Service create/rebind/holder/currentStep/transition and RelayWorkflowSession current/reconcile/settle are real. Public Host.Contribution supports replacements and TaskGovernance exposes hooks, but none is a complete C07 dispatch/receipt boundary. Calling lower-level arm/transition APIs with self-authored approval/binding/revalidate facts would replace canonical governance. Calling TaskGovernance.admit alone misses Task checks and does not provide the full native mapping.

The missing knowledge resolver/Archie author blocks workflows that cite knowledge references, not every readonly publication/catalog or every anchor-free materialization. For anchored workflows both the public canonical resolver and plan/upstream-derived Archie author are missing. Exporting the resolver alone is insufficient; the current authorSession returns an SF resident profile and UI supplies none.

Watch has two separate missing pieces: its descriptor is not incorporated into the host descriptors, and its actual callback ends unconditionally in native-watch-admission-port-unavailable after successful case/condition checks. Adding only the descriptor would expose a deterministic refusal. Native authorization, schedule/occurrence identity and owner binding are still required. Watch is separate from the five C07 callables.

requireParent checks a genuine recorded task part with non-pending decodable input equal to executor input. It does not independently require status===running. This report makes no claim that completed exact retries are denied merely because of their status.

evidence.fact: Tool.dynamic execute receives the real canonical Tool.Context, before bridge.call. Legitimate host-only capture is technically possible in this owned path.

requireParent rereads actual parent placement and assistant ownership, requires recorded part.name task and exact non-pending decoded input equality. A captured sf_* context fails the tool-name identity.
Host constructs routineServices with publication and prepareWatch but without native; it deliberately does not advertise routineServices.descriptors.
Even with a real case/condition/current materiality, prepareWatch returns native-watch-admission-port-unavailable. Registration alone cannot implement it.
Resident grants end with default deny plus selected skills and selected sf_* operations; Task is not a selected frozen SF operation.

Public Relay create/rebind/holder/currentStep/transition exist. evaluate refuses workflow-bound arms with WORKFLOW_NATIVE_SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED; transition requires authoritative binding, settlement, revalidation and host checks supplied by canonical workflow host.
Public current/reconcile/settle concern an already stored native WorkflowBound. The global host registered by Maestro exposes current/settle, not admit/grade via this public projection.

Canonical workflow admission requires real governance/authorization, same-parent arm, exact latest plan revision/parameters/ordered write paths and native upstream attribution. It records actual assistant/call identity and delegates to native host.
Native host owns approved placement, publication revalidation, terminal checks and durable WorkflowBound adoption; its public SessionHost registration projects only current/settle.
No exports for WorkflowKnowledgeV2, WorkflowRelayV2, MaestroWorkflowHostV2, WorkflowAdmissionV2 or authoritative GovernanceRecords/WorkflowRecords readers.
Resolver requires same-project actual Archie author Session, native Archie seat, unique completed non-provider atlas_context anchor call, exact input/identity/digests and current source reread.
Installed authorSession returns only the bound resident SF Session, UI returns none; knowledge always holds. Public readonly AuthoringStore/Skill publication is otherwise composed.
Knowledge resolver/author are required only when the sprint has knowledge references. Public admission checks runnable compilation; it is not governed Task/C07 authorization.

Consumer requires immutable native execution receipt, admitted input digest, output digest emitted at completion, correlated artifact and current authorization; generic Session/currentStep/model result does not satisfy this contract.

Private MCP only lists/calls provided descriptors, uses one-use operation/digest lease, verifies native capability receipt and final revalidation. It does not generate governed Task approval or C07 terminal receipt.
Native scheduler started is durable prompt admission; routine state/result still requires real C07 mapping plus execution and artifact readers.
